# 4.10 Tenth assembly district.
All of the following territory in Milwaukee County constitutes the 10th assembly district:
(1) The village of Shorewood.
(2) The city of Glendale.
(3) That part of the city of Milwaukee comprising U.S. census tract 2300, blocks 1006, 1011, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 3006, 3007, 3009, 3010, 3011, 3012, 3013, and 3014;
